text:
The canvas holds:
add-payee-details — Serves seq 12 (scope: a personal customer, in-app, paying a new UK sort code and account number, once, now) and seq 7 (customer must complete payee creation alone, in-app) — this is the entry screen where the customer types the new payee's details.
confirm-payee-result — Serves seq 6 (the agent's undocumented "close match" explanation step, now surfaced for the customer to read themselves) and seq 7/seq 23 (customer must resolve a non-match Confirmation of Payee result unaided, and cannot skip the check) — shows the name-check result and requires the customer to confirm or go back before proceeding.

Propose the next screen.

input.why: Serves seq 6 (the undocumented balance-check step before the first payment, so a short account doesn't cause a failed retry) and seq 23/seq 11 (the first-payment limit for new payees is enforced and stated up front) — lets the customer pick which account to pay from and enter the amount for this first payment to the new payee.

props.label: Amount
props.hint: New payees have a first-payment limit of £1,000 while we confirm this account
